claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's passive and reaction mechanics depend on its current authored form, and the current condition surface can only express generic equipment state such as holding or wearing.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item can be toggled to emit or extinguish dim light, and there is no current effect atom for light emission.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet ... or you can extinguish the light"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_weapon_properties
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The quarterstaff-form ranged rider adds the Thrown property and explicit normal/long ranges to the weapon, which the current surface cannot express honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: return_weapon_to_hand
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a deterministic post-attack return rider that is not represented by any existing effect atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand."
